note: src/app/api/agents/automation/route.ts POSTs to BrowserAutomationAgent.run(), which internally launches a Playwright chromium instance inside the Vercel Node.js serverless function itself (not the Railway worker). The chromium binary is not present in that runtime, so every trigger fails immediately with status:failed before any form-fill or navigation occurs. This is separate from the mature submission_queue/worker/queue-processor.ts AutoApply pipeline on Railway, which does have its own browser automation and is not affected by this finding.
